tools.name: compute-day-count-to-settlement
tools.description: Use when you need a Canadian settlement date or accrual fraction. Rolls a trade date forward on the Payments Canada calendar and counts the accrual under ACT/360, ACT/365F, 30/360, 30E/360 or ACT/ACT-ISDA. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

tools.name: convert-unix-timestamp-to-date
tools.description: Use when you need Unix timestamps as dates. Converts one or more timestamps, seconds or milliseconds, one per line, to UTC dates in ISO 8601 as a CSV. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

tools.name: decode-base64-to-text
tools.description: Use when you need to read base64 as text. Decodes standard base64 to UTF-8 text and refuses anything that is not valid base64 or not valid UTF-8, rather than guess. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

tools.name: diff-two-line-lists
tools.description: Use when you need to compare two lists of lines. Marks each distinct line only_a, only_b or both, matched exactly as sent, as a CSV. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

tools.name: add-business-days-to-date
tools.description: Use when you need the Canadian business day a count lands on, or to check whether a date is a business day. Moves a start date forward 0 to 260 business days on the Payments Canada calendar and names each closure day passed. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compute-day-count-to-settlement" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

It refuses rather than guesses: a missing ackno" → after: "Use when you need a Canadian settlement date or accrual fraction. Rolls a trade date forward on the Payments Canada calendar and counts the accrual under ACT/360, ACT/365F, 30/360, 30E/360 or ACT/ACT-ISDA. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free."
